output.reason: The regulation grants a government-borne PPh 21 facility (DTP) on the full gross income of certain permanent employees earning a fixed, regular gross income of no more than Rp12,000,000. It covers employers in labour-intensive industries (footwear, textiles and apparel, furniture, leather) with the KLU codes listed in Lampiran A. It applies to tax periods January to December 2025. This facility changes the net PPh 21 borne by permanent employees and how it is treated: the DTP amount is paid in cash and is not counted as taxable income.
